name: app-factory
description: Portable AI software-development factory with system/API governance, independent verification, autonomous context, capability-based execution, local learning and semantic proof.

interface.shortDescription: Build real systems with proportional architecture and independent proof.
interface.longDescription: A portable software-development factory that activates from software intent, classifies real system architecture and API Engineering governance proportionally, recovers repository context and autonomous state, materializes semantic contracts for relevant work, routes each action to capable backends, uses GitHub CI and free/open-source Independent Verification for deterministic/adversarial proof, requires decoupled semantic review when risk warrants it, and conservatively learns from privacy-safe local execution metadata without making Codex or any vendor mandatory.
defaultPrompt: Create a real software system with proportional architecture and prove the intended behavior.
Resume this project, preserve its baseline and continue with the safest capable backend.
Design or evolve this API with proportional contracts, compatibility and executable evidence.
Verify this robust system with free independent adversarial checks in CI when risk warrants it.
